# Mitch Henderson {.home-name .unnumbered .unlisted}

::: home-lede
I use data and statistical models to answer practical questions in sport.
:::

I have a PhD in sports science and work in data science at NSW Health, the state government health department. Sport is the field I care most about, and this is where I bring the modelling, statistics and programming I use every day to its problems: wrangling messy tracking exports, visualising athlete data so it gets used, and building models that are honest about what they don't know.

Most posts include the complete code in both R and Python so you can run it on your own data.
